facts.title: Learn Leatherworking
facts.location: Adele Fielder, small house by Crystal Lake, north-east of Goldshire
facts.note: No level requirement in Forever. Adele teaches only Apprentice, to skill 75. No supply vendor beside her: Salt and Coarse Thread are sold by Tharynn Bouden in Goldshire.

facts.title: Leatherworking 1-55: Light Leather, then Cured Light Hide
facts.note: 1-30: Light Leather from Ruined Leather Scraps (yellow at 20), or Light Armor Kits if you have Light Leather. 30-55: Cured Light Hide, 1 Light Hide and 1 Salt each. Keep 24 of the hides for Light Leather Pants at 100.

facts.title: Camp Tent (Leatherworking 20)
facts.location: Leatherworking trainer, or the Camping 101 quest
facts.note: 5 Light Leather. Rested experience up to 5% of a level, once an hour.

facts.title: Journeyman Leatherworking
facts.location: Simon Tanner, the Protective Hide, Old Town, Stormwind
facts.note: Needs Leatherworking 50 and level 10. Randal Worth in the same shop teaches only Apprentice.

facts.title: Leatherworking 55-130: gloves, belts, pants
facts.note: 55-75 Embossed Leather Gloves; 75-80 Medium Leather; 80-90 Cured Medium Hide (keep them); 90-100 Fine Leather Belt (keep 10); 100-115 Light Leather Pants; 115-125 Dark Leather Belt; 125-130 Heavy Leather. Most Classic recipes turn grey 25 points earlier in Forever.

facts.title: Expert Leatherworking is in Darnassus
facts.note: Needs Leatherworking 125 and level 20; 50 silver. He is the only Alliance Expert trainer listed. A Tanning Rack (Leatherworking 140, blueprint from Shadowfang Keep) is needed for many later recipes.
